---
title: "Known limitations"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Known limitations}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r include-diagnostics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
diagnostics_path <- file.path("vignettes", "d3-drawing-diagnostics.md")
if (!file.exists(diagnostics_path)) {
  diagnostics_path <- "d3-drawing-diagnostics.md"
}

diagnostics_lines <- readLines(diagnostics_path, warn = FALSE)
if (length(diagnostics_lines) > 0L &&
    identical(trimws(diagnostics_lines[[1L]]), "# Known limitations")) {
  diagnostics_lines <- diagnostics_lines[-1L]
}

knitr::asis_output(paste(diagnostics_lines, collapse = "\n"))
```
